0022600030.text: The Toronto Raptors (4-4, 2-3 on the road, on a one-game losing streak) visit the Milwaukee Bucks (1-7, on a four-game losing streak) in this Emirates NBA Cup East Group A matchup, Toronto's ninth game of the season. Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture) are both out for the Raptors, while Kam Jones is day-to-day with an ankle injury and is a game-time decision for Milwaukee. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but Toronto won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 122-94 win in Milwaukee on February 22, 2026.
